facts.claim: A certificate of registration is issued on payment of a fee not exceeding 115 rupees.
facts.subject: certificate_of_registration
facts.evidence: This behalf in such form and in such manner and on payment of such fees, not exceeding One Hundred fifteen rupees

facts.claim: A duplicate certificate of registration is issued on payment of a fee not exceeding 110 rupees.
facts.subject: duplicate_certificate_of_registration
facts.evidence: Where it is shown to the satisfaction of the Secretary of the Council that a certificate of registration has been lost or destroyed,the Secretary may, on payment of such fees, not exceeding One Hundred ten rupees (i.e. included administrative charges of Rs.100/-), as may be specified by regulations, issue a duplicate certificate in such form as may be specified in the regulations.

facts.claim: An application form or printout from an online filled application is required for registration.
facts.subject: registration
facts.evidence: Application Form or print out from online filled application.

facts.claim: An attested photocopy of the B.V.Sc. & A.H. degree certificate is required for registration.
facts.subject: registration
facts.evidence: Attested photocopies of Degree (B.V.Sc. & A.H.) Certificate.

facts.claim: Two self-attested passport size photographs are required for registration if not applied online.
facts.subject: registration
facts.evidence: Two Self Attested(Back side) Passport size Photograph (Pl.Do Not stapled) if not applied online.

facts.claim: Any one proof of date of birth is required for registration.
facts.subject: registration
facts.evidence: Any one proof for Date of Birth i.e. L.C./SSCE Certificate/Driving licence/ Passport etc.

facts.claim: An address proof is required for registration.
facts.subject: registration
facts.evidence: Address Proof.

facts.claim: Renewal of registration is compulsory every five years as per the IVC Act, 1984.
facts.subject: registration
facts.evidence: As per the provisions of IVC Act. 1984 renewal of registration every five years is compulsory; otherwise registration is liable for cancellation.

facts.claim: Provisional registration is issued to graduates who have completed their academic requirements for the degree course.
facts.subject: provisional_registration
facts.evidence: The state Council shall issue provisional registration certificate in Form-XXIV to such graduates who have completed their academic requirements for the degree course.

facts.claim: Every graduate must get provisional registration before undergoing internship training.
facts.subject: internship_training
facts.evidence: Every graduate is required to get himself/herself registered provisionally before being allowed to undergo internship training for the prescribed period.

facts.claim: Provisional registration is limited only for the internship training.
facts.subject: provisional_registration
facts.evidence: The provisional registration shall be limited only for the internship training.

facts.claim: Graduates must apply for provisional registration on the prescribed Form-XXII through the Dean/Principal of the Veterinary College.
facts.subject: provisional_registration
facts.evidence: Every Graduate shall be required to apply for the provisional registration on the prescribed Form-XXII through the Dean/Principal of the Veterinary College concerned from where he/she completed academic course.

facts.claim: On completion of internship training, graduates must apply for permanent registration and surrender their provisional certificate.
facts.subject: permanent_registration
facts.evidence: On completion of internship training, every graduate shall apply for permanent registration and shall surrender his/her provisional certificate along with application for registration to the State Council.

facts.claim: A final certificate of registration is issued to veterinarians who were registered at the council before the year 2007 on payment of a fee of 150 rupees.
facts.subject: final_certificate_of_registration
facts.evidence: Application on payment of fees of Rupees One Hundred Fifty only (i.e. included administrative charges of Rs.100/- and I-card Charge Rs.25/-) with any other dues i.e. Renewal Fees only.

facts.claim: The original registration certificate must be submitted to the council for getting a new registration certificate.
facts.subject: new_registration_certificate
facts.evidence: Original Registration Certificate should be submitted to council for getting new Registration Certificate.

facts.claim: An attested photocopy of the B.V.Sc. & A.H. degree certificate is required for the final certificate of registration.
facts.subject: final_certificate_of_registration
facts.evidence: Attested photocopies of Degree (B.V.Sc. & A.H.) Certificate

facts.claim: An additional degree certificate self-attested copy is required for the final certificate of registration.
facts.subject: final_certificate_of_registration
facts.evidence: Additional Degree certificate self attested copy
